assessment.answer: The score of 0.615 comes mainly from a balance sheet where liabilities are 8.35 times assets and the current ratio is 0.05. Both are in the worst 3-4% of 878 peers. Operating income and operating cash flow are also deeply negative. The reported net loss (-$21.5M annualized) looks milder than the business really is, because non-cash fair-value gains on warrants and derivatives offset it. So the model may even understate the distress. The filings confirm the distress is real. Cash was $3.0M at September 30, 2024 against a $4.0M minimum-liquidity covenant, about one month of last-quarter burn. All convertible notes were reclassified to current. The company is living on forbearances, discretionary $4M secured draws and a lender-driven restructuring process whose documents already include bankruptcy financing covenants.
moved_by: Cash of $3.0M at 2024-09-30 against Q3 operating burn of about $8.8M ($32.2M nine-month minus $23.4M six-month), about 1 month of runway. Even adding post-quarter inflows (Oct 7 $4.0M draw, about $3.0M gross offering, $0.5M ATM), the runway is only about 3-4 months.
Cash is below the $4.0M minimum-liquidity covenant. The company needed a forbearance from July 3, 2024, extended in short steps only through October 31, 2024.

Management says continued covenant compliance over 12 months is unlikely, so all Convertible Notes ($62.9M face) were reclassified to current. A default could accelerate them, and cash cannot cover that.

The August 2024 debt deals require hiring a financial advisor agreeable to the noteholders, a restructuring milestone schedule and a cash flow forecast. The A&R indenture adds covenants on financing if the company seeks bankruptcy protection.

The company received a Nasdaq delisting determination for the $50M MVLS rule, and any Panel extension runs no later than December 9, 2024. Delisting is a Fundamental Change that lets secured noteholders demand a cash repurchase.

Interest on the 2028 notes was paid in kind (June 2024), and non-priority 2028 notes get PIK-only interest. The debt is growing, and new money is layered as senior secured ahead of the existing notes.
The debt exchanges were accounted for as troubled debt restructurings because the company is experiencing financial difficulty.
